# SC Regulations Cheat Sheet

> SCDNR eRegulations 2026–27, checked 10/11/2026. [Official regs](https://www.eregulations.com/southcarolina/fishing). Regs change, and red drum changed **July 1, 2026**.
> When sources conflicted, the **stricter** rule is listed and flagged.

## 2026 changes that matter this fall

- **Red drum (S.961 / Act 231, eff. 7/1/2026):** slot **18–25″** (was 15–23″), **1/person/day**, **2/boat** (was 2 and 6). Nearly every fall bull red must be released.
- **Circle hooks (eff. 7/1/2026):** natural bait on a hook **4/0 or larger** for saltwater gamefish (red drum, seatrout, cobia, tarpon, striped bass) must be a **non-offset, non-stainless circle hook**. Artificial lures and hooks under 4/0 are exempt.
- **Blue catfish (Act 120, eff. 5/15/2026):** 150/day in most waters; **25/day** in Santee Cooper and the Pee Dee River (NC line → US 301 bridge); max **2 over 32″** in those waters plus the Congaree and Wateree rivers.

## Licenses (resident, verified dnr.sc.gov 10/11/2026)

| License | Price | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Annual freshwater | $10 | 3-yr $30 · 14-day $5 |
| Annual saltwater | $15 | 3-yr $45 · 14-day $10 |
| Combination | $25 | Hunting + big game + **freshwater** only. **No saltwater.** |
| Sportsman | $50 | Adds WMA access. **No saltwater.** |
| Under 16 | free | No license required |
| Lifetime freshwater (16–63) | $300 | |
| Lifetime saltwater (16–63) | $300 | Or $200 as an add-on to a $500 lifetime Combination |
| Lifetime Combination (ages 2–15) | $400 | + $160 saltwater add-on. Only lifetime option sold to kids |
| Senior fishing (64+) | $9 | Lifetime, **fresh + salt** |

Lifetime licenses need 180 days of SC residency. Lifetime vs annual math: [license.md](license.md#lifetime-licenses-worth-it-prices-verified-dnrscgov-10112026).

No license needed: on a licensed public pier (blanket license), on a licensed charter, or with ≤3 drop nets/traps/hookless handlines.
SC license = exempt from the federal NOAA angler registry.
